title: Amy Reynolds taken and found at a petrol station 790 km away
place_text: petrol station 790 km from where she was taken

tellings.quote: Amy ryance is probably one of my favorite cases in this regard because she was taken her friend Petra watched her being taken through the window all of a sudden they get this call that she's been found at a petrol station 790 km away

plain: A woman named Amy Reynolds was taken while her friend Petra watched through a window, and soon afterward the friends got a call saying she had been found at a petrol station 790 kilometres away. The researcher Mike Masters calls it "probably one of my favorite cases" and tells it on an episode about his idea that the beings behind such events are humans from the future, without naming where he learned of it. If true, she covered that distance in a way no ordinary travel explains.
